title: RAW UNREVIEWED: exclude all nilpotent common-endpoint paragraph actions through maximal-subgroup quotients
summary: A proposed source-free corollary of the existing1286integer left-inverse certificate. Under unchanged paragraph/unit premises, fixed reversible symbol actions with one common start and natural endpoint cannot have a nontrivial reachable orbit when their finitely generated action group has every maximal proper subgroup normal; this includes every finite or infinite nilpotent group. No state-count, key, source vocabulary or meaning choice. The existing nontrivial S3countermodel remains outside the excluded class.

design.mechanism: Necessary finite-group/abstract-group quotient obstruction to a broad reversible paragraph-completion convention, not an encoder or translation.
design.unit: The exact inherited1259/1286complete paragraphs and22working units, separately for ZL3b andIT2a. RF paragraph metadata remains unscorable.
design.contrast: Existing corollary excludes two-state and finitep-group actions. Proposed class removes finiteness and fixed-prime-order restrictions while retaining an explicit group-structure premise. It does not claim all noncommutative, solvable or reversible actions are excluded.
premises: Every working unit s acts through one fixed permutation g_s of a state set, possibly infinite. No position, page, source-word or hidden-input dependence is added to g_s.
Every inherited complete paragraph starts at the same state x and reaches the same natural endpoint y before any reset. A reset that discards an arbitrary endpoint is outside this rule.
Let G be the group generated by the22permutations and H=Stab_G(x). The relevant orbit is G.x; a nontrivial reachable orbit means H is proper. Extra unreachable states carry no inference.

The existing augmented count matrix A and integer certificate C obey C A=I23. Thus for every abelian group, fixed sign weights plus a common paragraph total satisfy only the zero solution. No new source counts or certificate verification has run in this proposal.
Main group-class premise: every maximal proper subgroup of G is normal. A separately proved sufficient condition is nilpotency of G; no assumption of commuting generators is needed.
general_obstruction_lemma: Use a right action and fix one observed paragraph word w0. Each word wi obeys x.wi=x.w0, so wi*w0^-1 belongs to H.
Suppose there is a nonzero homomorphism phi:G→B to an abelian group with H contained in ker(phi). Then phi(wi)=phi(w0) for every paragraph.
Set each sign weight to phi(g_s) and the common total to phi(w0). These obey A(weights,total)=0. Multiplying the existing integer identity C A=I23 gives every phi(g_s)=0 and total=0.
The g_s generate G, so phi must be zero, contradiction. Thus no such nonzero abelian quotient can kill the whole stabilizer.
main_class_proof: G is finitely generated by the22symbol actions. Every proper subgroup H lies in a maximal proper subgroup M: in a chain of proper subgroups containingH, a union equal toG would contain all finitely many generators in one chain member, contradicting properness. Zorn therefore suppliesM.

By the declared class premise M is normal. Since M is maximal as a SUBGROUP, G/M has no nontrivial proper subgroup. Any nonidentity element generates it, so it is cyclic, and it must have prime finite order (an infinite cyclic group has proper nontrivial subgroups).
The quotient homomorphism G→G/M is therefore nonzero abelian and kills H, contradicting the general lemma. Hence H=G and the orbit ofx is trivial.
nilpotent_inclusion_proof: Let 1=Z0⊆Z1⊆...⊆Zc=G be a finite upper-central series for a nilpotent G, with no assumption thatG is finite.
For any proper subgroup M, choose the least i for which Zi is not contained inM. Then Zi-1⊆M. Choose z inZi outsideM.
For each m inM, the commutator ofz andm lies inZi-1⊆M. Both z andz^-1 therefore normalizeM; hence N_G(M) strictly containsM.
If M is maximal proper, its normalizer must beG, soM is normal. Thus every finitely generated nilpotent action group satisfies the main class premise.

additional_scoped_consequence.claim: A solvable action group is also excluded if the start stabilizerH is normal and the orbit is nontrivial; equivalently a nontrivial solvable regular quotient action is impossible under the same paragraph equations.
additional_scoped_consequence.proof: IfHnormal andG/Hnontrivial solvable, its abelianization is nontrivial: a nontrivial perfect group cannot have a terminating derived series. The resulting abelian quotient ofG killsH, contradicting the lemma.
additional_scoped_consequence.limit: Normality ofH is essential. No assertion that all solvable groups, all small state counts or all individual involution generators are excluded.

preserved_countermodel.known_fact: The old source-free countermodel has a full-rank/index1augmented count lattice and a nontrivial three-state orbit with generated groupS3. Its start stabilizer is an order2maximal subgroup that is NOT normal. It is therefore not a counterexample to the proposed theorem but forbids broadening it to every solvable action.
preserved_countermodel.not_native: These artificial words and permutations are not native signs, candidate plaintext or a Voynich state machine.

design.human_mechanism_scope: Covers commuting counters and the larger nilpotent class of reversible updates, regardless of state cardinality, when the entire paragraph naturally completes to a common state. Group classification concerns the GENERATED transformation group, not the count of states or orders of individual moves. No claim that a medieval writer chose such a group.
design.smallest_adequate_followup: Independent proof review of the subgroup/maximality/normalizer steps and replay of the existing1286integer certificates and oldS3scope fixture. No new native census, group-size sweep, decoder, source corpus or symbolic alphabet fit is necessary. If a proof premise fails, preserve the old finitep-group result and stop this extension; if verified, publish it as a conditional class corollary, not a translation.
design.no_repair: Do not change paragraphs, tolerate errors, add source-dependent actions, alter native units or infer nontriviality on unreachable states. This is not a rescue of prior source writers.

predecessors.retained: All-abelian fixed paragraph completion excluded by the exact integer left inverse. That original outcome and source scope remain unchanged.

Two-state and finitep-group consequence plusS3countermodel already exist. This proposal only widens the rigorously stated action-group class; it is not a new native observation. The old stale review flag is not altered.

Ordinary line-difference subgroup, not normal closure, gave a nontrivial finite compatibility witness for a different line/alphabet scope. Do not turn that compatibility into a paragraph fit or confuse point stabilization with identity of whole permutations.
Whole-WORD natural completion has its own unrestricted reversible exclusion from quotient/square witnesses. It does not automatically transfer to whole paragraphs and is not rerun.
